datasets.name: prognoz
datasets.sql:
SELECT cont.contractno, av.val_name,fil.name as filname ,cont.opendate,cont.closedate,intr.interest||'%' as intres,
       sbcm_stored_programs.get_customernamebyid (cont.customerid)AS custname,stat.facticaldebt,
       sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(ac.contractaccid)  as InterestAccNO,
       ar.pok_ostat ,round(sbcm_report.get_prognoz(cont.id ,:dat),2 ) as prognoz ,
         ar.pok_ostat+round(sbcm_report.get_prognoz(cont.id ,:dat),2 ) as sumprognoz                                                       
FROM sbcm_contracts cont,
       filial fil,
       avalute av,sbcm_contract_state stat,sbcm_contract_accounts ac,archost ar,sbcm_interests intr
WHERE  cont.currency = av.valute
AND cont.branchid = fil.ID and  intr.id# = cont.id
and cont.type# = 3 and ac.id#=cont.id and ac.interestaccid=ar.acc_id and ar.datdate=(select tek_dat from sysdat) and 
stat.id#=cont.id
 /*13*/
